title: Rook for the Mate
setup: Your queen and bishop both strike at g7, and the queen on b7 is the only extra defender of it.
hint: A rook is worth less than mate. Which check forces the one piece guarding g7 to look away?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc8+}} must be met by {{Qxc8}}, which drags the queen off the seventh rank. {{Qxg7#}} finishes with the bishop on b2 behind it. The rook was never the point. When mate is on, count the guards of the square, not the material.
